title: Cost Anomaly Review
description: Structured review when a project's cost deviates significantly from its peer baseline.

steps.title: Compare sanctioned cost against the peer baseline
steps.guidance: Review the peer median and deviation shown in the cost risk factor. Confirm the peer group (category, state, financial year) is a fair comparison for this project.
steps.evidence_hint: Risk factor evidence: peer_median, robust z-score, deviation_pct

steps.title: Verify the project estimate and sanction record
steps.guidance: Request or review the detailed cost estimate behind the sanction. Check whether scope, site conditions, or approved revisions explain the higher cost.
steps.evidence_hint: Project detail: recommended/sanctioned/revised cost, sanction record

steps.title: Check for approved cost revisions
steps.guidance: If a revised cost exists, confirm the revision was approved through the prescribed procedure and documented with reasons.

steps.title: Record a conclusion with reasons
steps.guidance: State whether the cost deviation is explained (site conditions, scope, approved revision) or requires escalation. This is a human determination — the anomaly score alone is not a conclusion.
